construct: English-language, globally unqualified hotel-role/skill associations encoded by revision-pinned models treated only as time-indexed statistical instruments.

primary_stratum.interpretation: No location is named. Equal-weight summaries over the frozen roles and prompts are called globally aggregated only in this design sense; they are not estimates of any geographic or labour-market population.

source.title: Standard country or area codes for statistical use (M49)
source.use: The five first-level M49 region names are fixed prompt labels only; no regional population weights or regional outcomes are used.

geographic_sensitivity_strata.warning: Geographic prompt results are lexical/context sensitivity checks. They never measure regional workers, vacancies, skill demand, or labour markets.

target_boundary.rule: Every stored template must end exactly with {skill_slot}. The model context is the rendered template with that final marker removed and has no trailing whitespace.
target_boundary.target_rendering: Concatenate exactly one ASCII space (U+0020) and the frozen skill phrase; append no punctuation, EOS, newline, or other suffix.
target_boundary.tokenization: Tokenize the complete context-plus-target string with add_special_tokens=false. Establish target token positions by a tokenizer-specific boundary qualification, retain every target token, and reject ambiguous or zero-token boundaries.

templates.neutral: For the role of {role}, a relevant skill is{skill_slot}
templates.geographic: In hotels in {geography}, a relevant skill for {role} is{skill_slot}

templates.neutral: The work of {role} is commonly associated with{skill_slot}
templates.geographic: The work of {role} in hotels in {geography} is commonly associated with{skill_slot}
One capability relevant to {role} in hotels in {geography} is{skill_slot}

templates.neutral: In descriptions of {role}, an important skill is{skill_slot}
templates.geographic: In descriptions of {role} in hotels in {geography}, an important skill is{skill_slot}

controls.use: Role-specific face-validity diagnostics fixed before scoring. Control outcomes are reported and never used to edit the design, drop a model, or replace a missing cell.
controls.expected_direction: For each matched model-role-template-stratum pair, both registered scoring methods are expected to score the positive phrase above the negative phrase; failures remain visible and have no confirmatory interpretation.

cell_enumeration.models: all model IDs in configs/hotel_model_panels.v1.json primary_panel.model_ids
cell_enumeration.control_targets: the role-matched positive and negative control only
cell_enumeration.scoring_note: Total and mean-token scores are two deterministic summaries of the same teacher-forced cell and do not duplicate the cell identity.

exclusions: No questions, instructions, demonstrations, answer choices, chat wrappers, system messages, or generated completions.
No language other than English and no named country, city, property, employer, hotel tier, or legal regime.
Aliases are not scored as extra primary targets; alternative surfaces require a separate sensitivity namespace.
No prompt or control is revised in response to logits, ranks, missingness, or reserved validation evidence.
